## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Each phase transition appends a record with claimed outcome, judged outcome,...

The system SHALL ensure that each phase transition appends a record with claimed outcome, judged outcome, the outcome distribution and the evidence Noul to loop-state.json phase_history.

#### Scenario: Each phase transition appends a record with claimed outcome, judged outcome,...

WHEN `adjudicate-phase-outcomes-in-shadow-mode` is implemented
THEN Each phase transition appends a record with claimed outcome, judged outcome, the outcome distribution and the evidence Noul to loop-state.json phase_history.

### Requirement: transition(state, outcome) still runs on the claimed outcome for the whole...

The system SHALL ensure that transition(state, outcome) still runs on the claimed outcome for the whole shadow period, proven by a replay test showing identical phase sequences.

#### Scenario: transition(state, outcome) still runs on the claimed outcome for the whole...

WHEN `adjudicate-phase-outcomes-in-shadow-mode` is implemented
THEN transition(state, outcome) still runs on the claimed outcome for the whole shadow period, proven by a replay test showing identical phase sequences.

### Requirement: The disagreement report attributes each disagreement to the side the next...

The system SHALL ensure that the disagreement report attributes each disagreement to the side the next review round vindicated, over at least one sprint of recorded autopilot runs.

#### Scenario: The disagreement report attributes each disagreement to the side the next...

WHEN `adjudicate-phase-outcomes-in-shadow-mode` is implemented
THEN The disagreement report attributes each disagreement to the side the next review round vindicated, over at least one sprint of recorded autopilot runs.

### Requirement: A degraded decision (helper returns None) is recorded via record_degraded...

The system SHALL ensure that a degraded decision (helper returns None) is recorded via record_degraded and leaves the existing behaviour unchanged, covered by a test.

#### Scenario: A degraded decision (helper returns None) is recorded via record_degraded...

WHEN `adjudicate-phase-outcomes-in-shadow-mode` is implemented
THEN A degraded decision (helper returns None) is recorded via record_degraded and leaves the existing behaviour unchanged, covered by a test.
